summary: No new update this turn. I used the remaining window to read the last unexamined source of substance, transport.go, which defines the RPC and Transport interfaces plus the optional pre-vote and close interfaces; the only relevant text is the SetHeartbeatHandler doc, which describes the fast pass as a way to avoid head-of-line blocking from disk IO and explicitly permits a transport to ignore the call and route heartbeats through the consumer channel. That is context consistent with the heartbeat record already made rather than new or contrary evidence, so I am re-submitting the unchanged draft update45.json, the last accepted file, and the controller should treat it as an exact unchanged update rather than a duplicate revision. Nothing else is warranted with the run clock nearly exhausted, and per the run rules expiry preserves existing work without a closing call, so I make no stop declaration. Closing state of this investigation: findings and bounded conclusions on CFT decision formation and progress, on context and authority transitions, and on the client contracts that connect them are recorded with exact sources and locators; protective-mechanism and test-coverage negatives are recorded so that passing suites are not mistaken for coverage, durable corrections are attached to the affected knowledge identifiers where later evidence narrowed or reframed an earlier claim, two cases of contrary evidence against my own records are preserved in the open, and a paused handoff lists the five findings that still await an executed witness plus the one question whose deciding material lies outside the captured snapshot.
